title: Angle Stream Inclination Payload
description: The canonical angle frame: degrees from vertical, 0 = vertical, increasing as the needle lies over. This is the quantity both apps measure, store and display; see angles/SPEC.md.
$comment: `link` is a verbatim copy of the one in frame-heartbeat.json; tests/py/test_schemas.py asserts they stay identical.

inclination_deg.description: Degrees from vertical. Explicit null is a sample the sensor could not resolve -- legal, and it means 'no angle'. It is NOT zero, and a subscriber that renders it as zero prints a vertical needle that is not there.

state.description: needle-guide's SerialPortClient link state, verbatim. Free-form on the guide side: carry it, show it, never branch on it.

live.description: True only for `connected`, i.e. sensor samples are actually flowing.
